statements.notes: Directions: As a dietary supplement, add one scoop (33 g) to 8 fl oz of water or milk (dairy, almond, oat, rice or soy) and mix or shake until smooth. For best results, liquid should be very cold. Mixes instantly without the use of a blender. For Extreme results, take approximately 30 minutes after workout.

Extreme Edge Whey Protein Isolate Powder delivers 26 grams of high-quality protein per scoop to help replenish amino acid pools in the muscle that are necessary for achieving significant increases in muscle size and mass. Plus, each scoop provides essential amino acids – including branched chain amino acids – for muscle building and repairing, immunoglobulins for immune support to combat transient immune suppression that often occurs after strenuous exercise, as well as a cellular hydration blend of naturally occurring electrolytes [potassium (K+), sodium (Na+), calcium (Ca2+), phosphorus and magnesium (Mg2+)].

Muscle contraction is dependent upon the presence of electrolytes. In fact, without sufficient levels of these key minerals, which can often be depleted during continuous strenuous exercise, muscle weakness or severe muscle contractions/cramping may occur, as well as dehydration.
Unlike some other whey protein isolate products on the market that are laden with artificial sweeteners, flavors and colors, the sports nutritional scientists at Extreme Edge use only naturally-derived sweeteners, flavors and colors in combination with whey protein isolate to help facilitate clean and pure performance.
Plus, this whey protein isolate powder is derived from grass-fed cows that are not treated with recombinant bovine growth hormone (rBGH) or antibiotics.

And instead of the common practice of using heat processed whey that could denature the protein and immunoglobulins, we employ cross-flow microfiltration, a special low temperature method that leaves the polypeptide chains (i.e., protein) and immunoglobulins intact, while removing excess fat and 98% of the lactose sugars that often cause bloating or cramping.
The Federal Government has determined there is no significant compositional difference in the milk or milk by-products from rBST or rBGH treated and untreated cows.
Key features
Contains the highest biological value (159) of any other protein source

Derived from free-roaming, grass-fed cows not treated with rBGH/antibiotics
Free of artificially-derived colors, flavors, and sweeteners
Microfiltered
98% lactose free
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Advice for off-season bodybuilders & endurance athletes
Combine one scoop of Extreme Edge Whey Protein Isolate with two servings of Extreme Edge Carbo Load. When combined as directed, you will receive the scientifically coveted ~3:1 ratio of carbohydrates-to-protein (i.e., 79 grams of carbohydrate to 26 grams of protein providing ~425 calories) to replenish glycogen and amino acid stores, as well as electrolytes in the body for faster recovery.
